title: Not what I expected..
text:
I've had two shipments from Amazon at their discounted price now, hoping maybe the first one I had gotten was maybe a dud. There's no way I'd ever want to pay a full subscription price for what you get?

The first one was painting coasters. It was an okay craft, and glad I only paid $6.
The second one just came, and it's a painted "barn quilt" on a frame. It's basically the same craft on different materials. Luckily, I also only paid $6.

Do you get different crafts if you sign up when it's not $6? The pictures they show of the sample crafts look awesome, and I'd probably pay for that! But if this promotion is supposed to be an example of future crafts, there's no way the price is justifiable.
label: negative
